A '''spotlight''' was a high-powered light source. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] mounted spotlights as a standard feature.<ref name="RPG" /> A proposed modified version of the [[GV/3-series guardian droid]] designed for search and research work was intended to have a spotlight added as part of its equipment loadout.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
